regions.today: Mainly dry and breezy this afternoon with variable cloud amounts and bright or sunny spells, just the odd light shower possible in the north. Highest temperatures of 16 to 20 degrees in a moderate to fresh and gusty westerly wind.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with variable amounts of cloud and clear spells. Continuing breezy with moderate to fresh westerly winds but the winds will ease in the south overnight. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 11 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Saturday, will be a dry day with a mix of cloud and warm spells of hazy sunshine. Highest temperatures of 16 to 20 degrees in light to moderate west to northwest winds.
